title: Code Evolver | Less manual interaction, multiple tasks
text: Code Evolver helps teams improve repositories with less manual coordination. It organizes development tasks across specialized agents, turning a shared goal into a structured workflow.

title: Analyzer Agent Team | From data to direction
text: That workflow can begin with data. The Analyzer Agent Team examines the data profile, identifies insights, and recommends a clear direction for improvement.

title: Code Evolver Agent Team | From direction to changes
text: With a direction in place, the Code Evolver Agent Team takes the next step. It scans the repository, plans tasks, implements changes, and reviews and validates the results.

title: Visit https://github.com/caigen/CodeEvolver
text: Explore Code Evolver on GitHub at github dot com, slash caigen, slash Code Evolver. Bring your data or your direction, and guide your next repository improvement.
